title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
authors: Dongzhou Cheng, Taoran Yi et al

tldr.zh: GPT-Policy 将示范视频关键帧、可选的对齐动作记录、目标图和执行历史组织成上下文，让无需额外训练的通用 VLM 通过工具调用生成末端位姿与夹爪指令，再由运动执行层转换为关节轨迹，并将观测和执行结果回填上下文，实现机器人操作中的在线适应。
tldr.en: GPT-Policy organizes demonstration keyframes, optional aligned action records, goal images and interaction history as context for an off-the-shelf VLM with no additional training; the VLM calls tools specifying end-effector poses and gripper commands, a motion execution layer converts these into joint trajectories, and observations and execution results update the context for online adaptation.

evaluation_scope.zh: 比较人类视频、机器人视频及动作、目标图、自交互历史、在线人机交互五类上下文，任务含毛巾／本子抓取、拧瓶盖、插拔插头、布局整理与移动探索等。论文列出 YAM、ARX X5 和 Morphi Kino 的双臂夹爪实现配置；配置支持不等于每个平台均完成全部任务评测。各实验条件重复 3 次，部分模型比较为单次运行；任务进度不能替代成功率。模型权重固定，反馈仅更新上下文；插值、IK 与时间规划负责运动执行，不代表已验证无碰撞或可靠接触，论文报告了双臂碰撞、执行与成功判断方面的不足。
evaluation_scope.en: Studies five context families: human videos, robot videos with actions, goal images, self-interaction history and online human interaction, across cloth/notebook pickup, bottle opening, plug manipulation, arrangement and mobile exploration. YAM, ARX X5 and Morphi Kino dual-arm gripper configurations are documented, without establishing full task coverage on every platform. Each experimental condition has three trials; some model comparisons are individual runs and task progress is not success rate. VLM weights stay fixed and feedback updates context. Interpolation, IK and time parameterization execute motions; they do not establish collision-free or reliable contact control. Inter-arm collisions and execution/outcome-verification failures are reported.
